project_decision: Defer yellow-to-green human sign-off until the final project review phase.
required_before_green: module-specific evidence dossier with primary sources, versions, applicability, discrepancies and limitations
explicit affirmative decision of the physician-owner for that dossier and module
privacy/information-governance review when health data or images are processed
automation_rule: Automated QA, AI-assisted review and synthetic cases cannot independently promote a yellow module to green.
